input: # Whole games and databases, PGN spec 8 and 18. The default start rule is
# `pgn`, so the result is always an array of games.
# 18: an empty file is a valid, if uninformative, PGN database.
# Import format does not always write the marker; its absence is not an error.
# --- a game is a tag section then a movetext section (8) ---
# --- 18: a database is a sequence of games ---
# A new tag section starts the next game even where the previous one wrote
# Blank lines between games are conventional, not required.
# A comment before the first move annotates the game, not a move.
# A tag pair after the movetext has started belongs to the NEXT game: a tag
# section only ever precedes its own movetext (8).
